messages:
tom_procurement: Heads-up—we've got a partial hold on the EU H100 backfill. FRA customs flagged missing export docs on 6 units. Can vendor confirm paperwork?

maria_infra: Ugh. Which serials? We routed them to eu-dedicated pool; apps already expecting capacity tomorrow.

kai_ops: Observability shows pending allocations for eu-west1; if these 6 don't clear we'll hit our 99th pct latency SLO for critical batch jobs. Need ETA.

david_vendor: Sorry — checking now with export team. quick note: original AWB split across two shipments, paperwork was on the primary only. The secondary's manifest lost the ECCN line.

tom_procurement: Noted. Can you refile ECCN for the secondary and get customs release? Any chance to re-AWB and reroute to AMS to avoid FRA backlog?

david_vendor: We can refile but typical refile + release is 48-72h at FRA. Re-AWB + reroute to AMS is possible but incurs extra forwarder fees (~€1.2k/unit) and pickup windows are in 24-36h.

anne_logistics: If we do AMS reroute we'll need new depot ETA and depot acceptance window. Also need temporary loaner allocation to cover 72h gap. Any loaners available in EU pool?
maria_infra: We have 4 loaner H100s in our EU pool.
